title: Storage Archive Roots Management UX and Activation Closeout
summary: Closes the accepted Storage archive-root operator work: compact root management, NAS volume/folder add flow, inactive-root deletion, runtime activation handoff, and clearer user-facing storage problem states.
changelog: Completes the Storage archive-root management UI with compact root rows, centered facts, icon actions and short problem badges.
Keeps root add on the NAS volume/folder selection model instead of exposing raw Docker/internal paths.
Routes archive-root activation through the setup-helper runtime handoff and restores previously active recordings after the switch.
Adds protected inactive-root deletion with confirmation, permission checks and recording-list cleanup.
Improves Storage wording/tests around root problems, automatic retention policy, files naming and operator-safe dialogs.
